text:
Asking rents in Cologne stand at a median of 15.55 €/m² (2026-06), up 6.1% on the year and +28.5% over five years. That ranks Cologne #4 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 66% above the 2022 average contract rent of 9.39 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 933 € a month in cold rent, 19.5% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 22 days and 36% are gone within a week; with 1.3% market-active vacancy and +0.3% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 16.33 €/m² (+5.0%), with an 80% range of 15.98 to 16.72 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
